data.reasoning: The package is a standard VCS AUR package that clones from its own declared upstream repository (github.com/areofyl/fetch), builds with make, and installs with make install. No malicious code, obfuscated commands, suspicious network requests, or injection patterns were found. The sha256sums=SKIP is normal for VCS packages. Report 2 successfully reviewed all files and found no issues. Report 1's inconclusive result was due to API errors (HTTP 400) when auditing PKGBUILD and .gitignore, not actual security concerns.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by tool errors in Report 1 (qwen3-235b), which failed to audit PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to HTTP 400 BadRequestError responses from the LLM API. Report 2 (deepseek-v4-flash) successfully completed all audits and found the package safe. The initial PKGBUILD gate check in Report 1 did succeed and found no dangerous top-level code, consistent with Report 2's findings.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to audit PKGBUILD and .gitignore due to API errors, leaving 2 of 3 files inconclusive
learnings: API reliability: Implement retry logic or fallback models when LLM API calls fail with transient errors (HTTP 400/500) to prevent incomplete audits
